A LAND OF GENEROSITY
01 — OUR STORYHOSPITALITY IS IN OUR NATURE

Here, a meal is
more than food.
It’s a welcome.

Local roots.
International tables.

We bring the generosity of Kurdistan to every table we serve.

Our catering journey began in 2016 at Mosul Dam, serving 1,450 people from local and international teams. Today, we cater for workplaces, airports, military personnel and events.

From familiar Kurdish flavours to international menus, our approach is simple: thoughtful food, carefully prepared and reliably delivered.

EXPERIENCE THAT TRAVELS

Local knowledge.
International experience.

Our work has brought local and international teams to the same table, from Mosul Dam to Erbil International Airport.

MOSUL DAM

A strong beginning.

Our first catering project served Trevi Group staff, Italian military personnel, the American Corps of Engineers and government officials.

Care across cultures.

Catering projects for the Canadian Armed Forces and the Italian Army, bringing together local, Western and Italian-inspired dishes.
